'''Varykino''' was an island in a [[Unidentified Naboo lake|lake]] at the [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that housed<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Varykino Villa/Legends|Varykino Villa]].<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Lake Retreat hosted a large [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebration. A group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], including [[Kkatamik]], traveled to the island in order to spread the ideals of Life Day.<ref name="SWG:WLD">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=event|Wookiee Life Day}}</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Lake Retreat appeared as a city in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes: 15 December 04|Publish 11.5]]" on [[December 14]], [[2004]], the Lake Retreat was the host of the yearly in-game event known as the Wookiee [[W:c:swg:Life Day|Life Day]].<ref name="P11.5">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=375|text=Update Notes - December 14, 2004 - Publish 11.5}}</ref> The Life Day event was later completely revamped and moved to other cities the subsequent years.<ref name="CLD">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67531&month=122007|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Celebrating Life Day}}</ref>

In the novel and film Doctor Zhivago, Varykino is the Uralian countryside estate of the Gromekos, the family with whom the orphaned Yuri Zhivago grew up.
